jobs.title: Client Advisor - Kazakhstan
jobs.description:
Do you look for a new challenge within the dynamic and fast paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Do you have a "can do" mentality and want to be part of our growth story and create impact? Are you a passionate relationship manager who delivers an exceptional client experience? Are you a proven risk manager?

We’re looking for a Client Advisor, in Doha, Qatar, covering Kazakhstan clients.

• build, establish and grow your client relationships within the HWN/UHNW segment
• extensive networker, proven acquisition talent and passionate knowledge of the HWN /UHNW field
• provide trusted advice to clients in collaboration with colleagues in investment products and solutions teams.
• extensive network in order to facilitate the acquisition of new HWN/UHNW clients
• have a plan to develop the client book with measurable outcomes
• experience in relationship management, asset gathering and investments, ideally 2-5+ years working in a client-facing role
• firm grasp of financial markets and regulatory frameworks
• ability to build strong client networks, with an entrepreneurial mind-set
• resilient team player and truly service oriented
• aptitude for digitization and technology
• keep accurate and up-to-date records
• comply with all regulations, policies and standards to be in line with our risk management culture

jobs.description:
Are you a true networker who loves to talk to potential clients? Can you also close a deal?
Do you have a strong track record in advising and sales?

If yes; our 18 months Wealth Management Associate Program extends your skills, provides a unique experience in Wealth Management and establishes a platform for accelerated career development in a client facing role. Parallel off-the-job education will provide you with the business specific knowledge, but the main focus is on-the-job, developing your book of clients. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be equipped with the necessary foundation to embark upon a rewarding career with UBS Wealth Management in one of our global locations.

We’re looking for someone who can:

• develop to become a successful Relationship Manager through our training program; reaching (or preferably exceeding) both the financial and educational targets set within the program
• build up a client book from your own existing network of wealthy individuals in Germany
• establish long-term mutually beneficial relationships with clients
• continuously grow your network by referrals and by identifying new prospects

• développer continuellement votre réseau par des références et en identifiant de nouvelles perspectives

jobs.title: Client Account Manager - International Clients
jobs.description:
Do you look for a new challenge within the dynamic and fast paced Wealth Management environment? Do you want to be part of a high performing team? Do you have a "can do" mentality and want to be part of our growth story and create impact? Do you want to proactively go the extra mile with us to help our sophisticated clients? Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for someone to:

• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• manage daily client transactions and carry out inquiries and troubleshooting
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• research, follow-up and resolve client inquiries and problems through effective interaction with clients, and internal partners in a timely and professional manner
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• support client advisors in administrative, risk and legal and compliance related tasks and duties
• join client advisors occasionally in client meetings

jobs.title: Internship in Finance Team
jobs.description:
Are you great with numbers?
Do you enjoy analysing financial information and understanding how the numbers tell a story?
Are you tech‑savvy and curious to learn how finance works in a global organisation?

We’re looking for an intern to join our Finance team who will support day‑to‑day accounting and reporting activities and gain hands‑on experience in a corporate finance environment.

In this role, you will:
• Support accounting and financial activities within the Finance function
• Prepare and deliver financial reports such as Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, close packs, and other management reports in an accurate and timely manner
• Analyse and investigate variances, ensuring required adjustments are accurately reflected in the general ledger
• Perform reconciliations and analyse financial data to support financial reporting and controls
• Collaborate with colleagues and contribute to improving the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of financial processes and internal controls
• Gain exposure to financial reporting processes in a global organization and develop practical finance and analytical skills

jobs.title: Associate Director, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Software Engineer in Morrisville, NC
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Software Engineer to:
• Design, implement, and maintain a scalable CI/CD platform to automate code integration, testing, deployment, compliance verification and infrastructure provision for software development teams across all divisions. Embed security best practices into the software development lifecycle by automating vulnerability scans, compliance checks, and secure code deployment and meet UBS policies and standards.
• Liaise between platform engineering and application development teams, promoting best practices and reusable solutions. Design platform monitoring and logging solutions to track performance, detect anomalies, and ensure system stability. Integrate machine learning models and services into the developer platforms, enabling intelligent automation and enhanced developer productivity.
• Integrate observability tools to provide actionable insights and support proactive incident response. Provide documentation, training, and support to enable teams to effectively use developer platform tools and services. Develop and maintain operational infrastructure and tooling to support software artifact deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
• Reducing manual intervention and accelerating delivery cycles. Manage and provision infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Ansible, ensuring consistent, repeatable, and auditable infrastructure deployments. Collaborate with various teams to define standards and templates for bank wide adoption. Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 002681. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary & Work Schedule: $130,000/year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. jobs.title: Data Scientist

• provide auditors with training and support, as required, to effectively use data-driven tools and solutions.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for role guiding families of exceptional financial success on matters related to doing good with wealth for loved ones and the communities they care about? Reporting to the Head of Family Advisory & Philanthropy Services, U.S., you’ll operate within the UHNW coverage and advisory model as an extension of the Financial Advisor team. You’ll support clients across the full lifecycle, from early liquidity and succession planning through ongoing multigenerational stewardship.
You’ll be deployed selectively where family complexity, scale, and opportunity require deeper engagement, and where early involvement can shape long term outcomes for both clients and UBS.
You’ll also work as part of the global Social Impact & Philanthropy team, collaborating across regions and with colleagues in sustainability, impact investing, and social finance to build and scale solutions that advance the impact economy.

As a Senior Strategist you will:
• partner with Financial Advisors to identify opportunities for family advisory and philanthropy conversations and engage spouses, rising generations, and future decision makers early
• design and lead client engagements across governance, decision making, succession, leadership transition, next generation development, and family culture
• translate discovery discussions into practical outputs such as governance recommendations, decision frameworks, succession roadmaps, family meeting agendas, multigenerational engagement plans, and philanthropy strategies
• maintain momentum after meetings by clarifying decisions, ownership, and next steps, helping families move from intent to action
• increase adoption of the UBS Optimus Foundation as a platform for high-impact philanthropy where relevant
• act as a thought leader through client events and content
• track and report advisor and client activity in line with UHNW Advisory requirements, helping expand advisory scope, retention, and wallet share
• contribute to the ongoing development of Social Impact & Philanthropy offerings
• connect teams and capabilities across UBS

jobs.description:
Corporate Communications is charged with elevating, protecting and amplifying the reputation of UBS among internal and external audiences. To that end, Corporate Communications strives to position UBS as one of the world’s leading financial services providers, recognized thought leader, responsible corporate citizen, as well as employer, business partner, vendor, and investment of choice. In addition, Corporate Communications informs employees on strategy, performance and execution, and drives employee engagement to support revenue growth of UBS business divisions. Corporate Communications programs are geared towards influencing UBS’s primary audiences.

We’re looking for somebody to:

• develop and execute media strategy for UBS's Wealth Management Americas, Investment Bank and Asset Management businesses in the US, Canada and Latin America
• oversee social media strategy and planning for UBS’s Americas social channels
• build and foster strong relationships with members of the financial and industry trade press
• counsel members of the Firm's Americas senior leadership team on messaging, reputational risk, issues and crisis media management
• collaborate closely with colleagues in internal communications, investor relations, executive communications, community affairs, branding and business marketing to ensure consistency of messages to the Firm's external audiences
• manage a high performing media relations and social media team and direct external agency resources

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you a detail-oriented problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced, client-focused environment?
As a Client Onboarding Specialist, you will support Global Banking by executing the client onboarding process for clients involved in capital markets and corporate financing transactions. This includes completing the required Know Your Customer (KYC), regulatory, and tax onboarding requirements, and working with clients and internal stakeholders to gather, review, and validate the necessary information. Your work ensures clients are fully onboarded into our platform ahead of deal execution, and that all AML and regulatory obligations are satisfied in a timely and compliant manner.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
• Owning the end-to-end request intake process – monitoring the shared inbox, triaging new onboarding requests, and conducting open-source research on clients and transactions to determine onboarding requirements
• Conducting initial outreach to client counsel and internal business stakeholders to gather required documentation and information
• Maintaining accurate and up-to-date client and transaction records in the case workflow tool to ensure full pipeline visibility and organized case tracking
• Coordinating with client counsel and internal Global Banking deal teams throughout the onboarding lifecycle to obtain outstanding documentation and drive cases to completion
• Keeping cases current in the workflow tool as they progress, reflecting changes to deal timelines, outreach status, and case stage to support accurate reporting and team awareness
• Proactively communicating with deal teams to align on transaction scope or timeline changes, providing clear and timely onboarding progress updates
• Performing screening on clients and related parties, reviewing adverse media, and escalating matters to Financial Crime Prevention when required
• Preparing complete onboarding files, addressing feedback from the Quality Assurance team, and ensuring all documentation and data capture meet internal standards
• Acting as a single point of contact for the deal teams to ensure the client onboarding process is completed ahead of transaction timelines

jobs.description:
Are you interested in developing and driving solutions that advance UBS’s strategic objectives? Do you execute with excellence? Are you entrepreneurial, proactive, and forward looking?
As the Chief Compliance Officer and Chief Anti Money Laundering Officer, you will oversee and lead the Compliance function for UBS Securities Canada Inc. and perform the following:
• partner with legal counsel to ensure that policies, guidelines, standards and Compliance monitoring and testing procedures and business procedures are consistent with local regulatory requirements and interpretations of laws, regulations, rules or any other related industry regulatory standards or guidelines
• liaise with senior management as well as functional leaders in compliance, legal, risk, and IT to provide subject-matter expertise on existing, new, or updated laws, rules, and regulations as well as effective challenge, guidance, and advice
• participate in relevant Committees as well as various other global, regional, and cross-product committees
• draft and publish policies and procedures and maintain a local compliance training program
• participate and provide support in regulatory exams and inquiries
• complete Compliance Risk Assessments and thematic reviews to assess emerging risk themes
• running the IB Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) function for the Canadian IB Legal entities (working with FCP team members in Canada in the United States, and globally as applicable).
• acting as the local Money Laundering Reporting Officer / Chief AML Officer for the IB Canadian Entities – key duties will be: (i) Local Board Reporting on FCP Matters; (ii) contributing to the FCP Global Risk Assessment (which involves completing local Canadian Questionnaires annually); (iii) Owning and overseeing any local IB Canada specific compliance and AML/KYC policies, procedures and protocols (as well as any KPC attestations that relate to these local policies, procedures, protocols) to ensure they meet current regulatory expectations and are aligned with enterprise-wide standards.
• being the focal point for any GIA / Regulatory compliance exams (inclusive of AML / FCP exams) and interacting with provincial and federal regulators, including regulatory filings as applicable.
• implementing the IB FCP Framework of UBS' global IB Division, and ensuring compliance, operational and FCP risks are identified, properly assessed and managed.
• provide strategic direction and oversight to the IB / stakeholders in relation to IB FCP deliverables and initiatives (taking into account applicable : (i) legislation, (ii) rules and guidance, (iii) industry best practice).

jobs.title: Australia & New Zealand Securities Specialist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be at the center of equity trading operations in Australia & New Zealand?

Do you thrive working closely with the trading desk, taking ownership of risk outcomes, and improving how things are done?

We’re looking for a proactive Middle Office professional seeking genuine front office exposure, ownership of key controls, and the opportunity to drive meaningful process improvement and automation—primarily for New Zealand, with additional responsibility supporting Australia.

In this role, you’ll sit at the heart of the Australia & New Zealand Equities business, partnering closely with Trading, Business Management, clients, and global support teams. You’ll own critical front to back controls, ensure trade integrity, and play a key role in managing operational and risk outcomes on T0 and beyond.
You’ll be trusted to act decisively, think critically, and continuously improve how we support the business.

• Own and operate a suite of front to back controls, identifying and capturing risk events as part of the first line of defense
• Ensure T0 trade data integrity, with a strong focus on completeness, accuracy, and timeliness
• Produce and facilitate sign off for T0 risk reporting and T+1 reconciliations
• Act as a key point of contact for Australia & New Zealand Equities Trading desks and Business Managers, providing time critical support
• Liaise with clients and external brokers to resolve trade booking and economic discrepancies
• Partner with the business and local support functions on new initiatives, change, and process improvement to enhance efficiency and control
• Drive automation and continuous improvement, leveraging data and tooling to reduce risk and manual effort

• Provide data support to internal & external stakeholders
• Be comfortable within a geographically spread, fast-moving Agile team
• Continuously up-skill, learn new technologies and practices, reuse strategic platforms and standards, evaluate options, and make decisions with long-term sustainability in mind.

jobs.title: CA Intern
jobs.description:
WMCH UBS CH AG : Accountant (EE)
Are you great with numbers? Do you have attentions to the details? We're looking for someone like that who can help us:
In providing high quality accounting, reporting and analytical services to our Zurich based internal clients in EMEA Time Zone from Pune BSC, including:
• Preparation of complex accounting Journals, ledger integrity checks and control, account ownership sign off in BCS reconciliation, feed reconciliation, clearance of suspense balance
• Preparation and presentation of MoM/QoQ variance analysis with quality commentary and business drivers insight for senior management and diverse stakeholders
• Preparation and presentation of management accounts and variance analysis
• Detailed analysis and exception reporting for various feeds reported into Primary ledger from Accounting and system architecture perspective
• Preparation and consolidation of Divisional Notes to accounts for Fair Value, Off Balance sheet and various other topic post co-ordination across various LE controllers.
• Supporting various change the bank projects initiatives from respective accounts and disclosure owned by respective team member
• Co-ordination of all legal entity activity, with key internal experts such as tax, regional, group controlling, auditor etc.
• Strong hands on experience in ARP and advance MS-Excel skills required to generate and report various data analytics.
The role requires team collaboration skills in addition to being an individual contributor.
Re-engineering and standardization of processes as required and support business specific initiatives. Also to have the flexibility required to work in a dynamic environment under tight deadlines

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Market risk quant in the Market risk model validation team in India to perform:
• Independent validation of market risk models in line with the UBS model governance policy and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include
• Assess the model's conceptual soundness and methodology
• Check the appropriateness/quality of input data used for model development, review appropriateness of model parameters, accuracy of the model calibration etc.
• Review model outcome, impacts, or develop alternate benchmark approaches to challenge model outputs (as appropriate)
• Assess model risk, providing effective challenge to model assumptions and evaluate model limitations
• Write comprehensive validation reports, documenting the assessments to required standards
• Collaborate effectively with stakeholders globally to understand / challenge potential model risks; communicate validation findings to relevant stakeholders
• Support ongoing review of model performance and model change reviews to ensure models remain fit for purpose
